reveWebLead.thirdPartyEvidence: @gasolinaradar/dgt-ev-collector 1.5.1 documents live-tested public-map behavior, embedded tariffs/status and the same normalized consumer output shape for public and external sources. It states that connectorId/evseId are the reliable keys relating normalized prices and availability, and that availability.evses[] is the authoritative per-EVSE status representation. Any status merged onto the top-level DGT connectors is only best-effort and may be omitted when type/power matching is ambiguous.
reveWebLead.grossNetNormalizationEvidence: Matched examples strongly indicate the public-map representation is consumer-facing VAT-inclusive/rounded while the external API retains net price components plus vat=21. Examples: 0.8265*1.21≈1.00, 4.956*1.21≈6.00 and 0.566*1.21≈0.68. This explains at least part of the apparent raw/naive semantic mismatches but is not yet proof for all 32 matches.
reveWebLead.statusMappingEvidence: The maintained collector explicitly documents availability.evses[] as the authoritative per-EVSE state, with evseId/connectorId as the reliable relation keys. It also warns that top-level connector status is only a best-effort merge from DGT connector type + power and can be absent when ambiguous. Therefore the previous 0 officialStatusIdMatches must not be interpreted as status disagreement; the next comparator must map the public evse_id/connector IDs to the external operational_status identifiers before evaluating state parity.
reveWebLead.parityInterpretation: Raw or path-sensitive semantic inequality is not evidence of price disagreement. A VAT-aware component comparator must pair component type, step size, restrictions and dates before deciding equivalence. For availability, compare the authoritative public availability.evses[] records after deterministic identifier mapping, not the convenience status merged onto DGT connectors.
reveWebLead.nextSafeStep: Run a bounded offline comparator over the existing sample: tariff parity keyed by connectorId with VAT-aware component normalization, and status parity keyed by mapped evseId/connectorId against external operational_status. Do not run a national public sweep or promote this source yet.
